name: Notepattern
description: The Music Note ODP models a symbolic note and its symbolic attributes.
competency_questions: what is the name of a note?, what part of the score does a note belong to?, what are the dynamic indications referring to a note in the score?, what is the fundamental frequency of a note?, what are the different frequencies that make up the spectrum of a note?, what is the duration in seconds of a note, in a given performance?, how is the envelope of a note shaped?
